text: You just bought a water bottle with 500ml but you regret it, and you want to change it to the other bottle you just placed with 1000ml capacity. If the exact item is not available any more, you can allow the material to be different, but you want the color to be the same as your other 1L bottle.
zh: 你刚刚买了一个500毫升的水瓶，但你后悔了，想换成你刚才另外下单的那个1000毫升容量的瓶子。如果确切的商品已经没有了，你可以允许材质不同，但你希望颜色和你另一个1升瓶子的颜色一样。(#W1234567, #I500ML, 水瓶, #I1000ML, 水瓶)
